subject.title: [Feature Request]: Replace raw textarea with a structured JSON code editor (with folding support)

question: Should OpenClaw accept a bundled Control UI code-editor dependency for raw JSON5 config editing, and should that happen by rebuilding the existing open PR or by requesting a fresh narrower PR?
rationale: The request is aligned with web frontend ergonomics, but it adds a sizeable UI dependency and changes a sensitive config-editing surface where maintainer product and compatibility intent should decide the landing path.

options.title: Sponsor a rebuilt editor PR
options.body: Accept the CodeMirror-style direction only if the branch is rebuilt on current main, preserves sensitive raw config behavior, and includes real browser proof.

options.title: Keep the textarea for now
options.body: Decline the dependency/product surface until raw config editing becomes a higher priority or a lighter existing component is chosen.

options.title: Require a short design note
options.body: Keep the issue open but require a maintainer note comparing dependency choice, JSON5 formatting semantics, sensitive-value handling, and proof requirements before code work continues.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a rebuilt editor PR
recommendation.body: Accept the CodeMirror-style direction only if the branch is rebuilt on current main, preserves sensitive raw config behavior, and includes real browser proof.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is tied by history to the reveal-to-edit raw config behavior and is the strongest routing candidate for the product/compatibility decision.
